#bot.Expression.NoHappy
You: I can understand that you weren’t thrilled with these other decorations, but this spider plush we bought at Annalie’s is great right?
#bot.Expression.Happy
Bot: Yes! It’s very cute, I like it a lot!
You: Hehe, cute stuffed toys are every girl’s weakness after all.
#bot.Expression.NoHappy
Bot: It’s really squishy and nice to touch. I’m not even bothered by the anatomical discrepancies between this toy and real spiders.
You: T-that’s great to hear!
You: Although I think anatomically correct spider plush would be quite fearsome…
Bot: Isn’t that what Halloween is all about though?
You: Well…{{wi}} I think it’s important to not go overboard…
